description: Single-tweet paid-boost asset · drives cold-audience X traffic to galaxymind.space (the vendor directory, Galaxy Mind's most successful page). Opens with the canonical 'bitcoin can't be spent' complaint and refutes it with hard numbers + scannable categories. CTA is the bare apex URL, no subscription or signup friction at the destination. Designed to be A/B-able against recruitment-boost.json's tweet 1 since both target the same paid surface but with different goals (this = consumer browse traffic, that = vendor recruitment).
tweets:
"You can't really spend bitcoin on anything."

72 merchants on Galaxy Mind disagree.

A free directory of shops that take BTC for real goods. Apparel, hardware, food, art, books, services across 15 countries.

No subscription. No tracking.

galaxymind.space
